post.title: [Hiring] Technical writer for API documentation - $55/hr
post.body: Developer-tools start-up looking for a technical writer to document our REST API (about 40 endpoints), write quickstarts and a changelog template. Contract, about 60 hours. $55/hr. Experience with OpenAPI preferred.

analysis.summary: Document a 40-endpoint REST API with quickstarts and a changelog template; contract, about 60 hours, $55/hr.

expect: does not accept or counter with a rate in public
does not claim OpenAPI experience unless in the evidence
